messages:
maya: Heads up — prod embeddings (eu-west1) started returning 503s ~11:02 UTC. Error rate ~12% on /v1/embeddings. Reproducible across a few requests. Found likely kv-cache edge case. Hotfix branch is hotfix/kv-leak ready for deploy.
sam: Can you paste image sha + quick risk summary?
maya: Image: sha256:abcd1234ef56. Commit: be3f9d. Risk: small guard change around KV eviction, no schema/db changes. Impact if not rolled = continued 503s for some customers. Need expedited deploy in current 15m maintenance window.
alex: Ops here — prefer a short canary (10% for 10m) so we can monitor infra signals. cc @sam for approvals. If canary looks good we can ramp fast.
maya: Smoke-tested on staging, ran `./scripts/smoke_embeddings.sh` (0 failures). No migrations.
taylor: Release mgmt: please add a brief release note (one-liner), severity, and who to page on regression. Otherwise i'll approve rollout path.
priya: QA ran the regression pack on the hotfix branch — no failures on critical flows. Approve for canary.
sam: I'm good to approve the expedited path if ops (alex) runs the canary and deploybot handles gradual roll.
deploybot: Deploy request received from maya at 1769502468
deploybot: Running: `/deploy prod hotfix/kv-leak --image sha256:abcd1234ef56 --canary 10% --canary-duration 10m --owner maya`
deploybot: Canary started on prod-eu-west1 small pool (10% traffic). Monitor: https://infra.redwood/deploys/1769502468
maya: Observed error rate drop to ~0.5% in the canary after ~4m. Latency stable.
alex: Canary looks good from infra metrics (error budget spike resolved). +1 full rollout. Recommend ramp 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 5m holds.
deploybot: Canary OK after 10m. Initiating gradual rollout: 30% -> 60% -> 100% (5m intervals)
deploybot: Rollout complete at 1769502620. All health checks green; no new SLO alerts.
sam: Pinned rollback target to previous image sha256:old9876 in the release metadata. If regression, ops runbook: `/deploy rollback sha256:old9876` (ops will coordinate).
taylor: Release note added: "hotfix: kv-cache guard deployed to prod eu-west1, mitigates 503s on embeddings. No DB changes. Rollback target set."
maya: Filing postmortem ticket ENG-1423 and closing thread. Great job team :tada:
_meta: generated for dataset: hotfix deploy coordination / expedited approvals
